title: Enigma bu tron ​​bu sori bi
intro: Benn buur bu am doole, am nguur gu amul fenn, dafa jànkoonte ak jafe-jafe bu doy waar, muy benn reine bu bawoo ci réew mu sori. Buur bi dafa bëggoon wane doole ak xam-xam bu Yàlla jox, mu indi xew-xew bu yéeme buy xeex yooni jamono ak barab. Ndax mën nga xam bu baax li xew ci kéemtaan bi?
clues: Dañu daan jox njiit kàttan gu rëy, lu ci melni yor mbindéef yiñ dul gis, ak kàttan ngir wax ngelaw li.
Ndaw si dafa am xibaar ci benn reine bu am xaalis bu jaamu jant bi, muni dafay woo ko ci kër buur ba.
Laata reine bi di ñëw, njiit li dafa wax ni dafa bëgga indi toogukaay bu mag bi mu yor ci réewam bu sori bi.
Benn jinn bu am doole dafa bëggoon jëlaat mbir mi balaa njiit li di jog ci konsilam.
Waaye, ki am xam-xam bu xóot ci Mbindu Yàlla, moo gënoon gaaw ci wut mbir mi, ba noppi mu jeexal liggéey bi ci diir bu gàtt.
Bimu yegsee, njiit li daal di wax ñu soppi mbir mi ngir natt xel mi ak ni reine bi di gisee mbir mi, ginaaw bimu yeggee ci palaas bi.

outcome.label: Njureef
options: Reine bi di woyof ci Yallah
outcome.answer: Reine bi di woyof ci Yallah

verse: It was said to her, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace paved with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allah, Lord of the worlds." (An-Naml 27:44)
arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ادْخُلِي الصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةً وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُ صَرْحٌ مُّمَرَّدٌ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَانَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
